en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest – May 6, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include inclusive health equity approaches, new wheelchair mount technology, sponsorship of the CSUN Assistive Technology Conference, RJ Mitte’s keynote on inclusion, and a study on how delivery timescales affect accessibility outcomes.

highlights.title: KUPOCARE KMA-104 OmniReach Wheelchair Mount for Tablets and Phones

RJ Mitte speaks at And Justice for All Conference
Study Shows Delivery Timescales Affect Accessibility Outcomes
